page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.ebmc8y.32xlarge is an ECS Bare Metal instance built on the arm64 architecture. It is powered by Alibaba's custom Yitian YiTian710 processor running at 2.75 GHz, providing 128 dedicated virtual cores. System memory totals 256.0 GB, which establishes a compute-oriented allocation of 2.0 GB of memory per core. The server utilizes KVM virtualization capabilities within a bare-metal execution environment.

The instance contains no integrated local storage drives, requiring workloads to rely on attached network block storage for persistence. Discrete GPU accelerators are not present. Network performance is characterized by a baseline bandwidth of 64 Gbps, facilitating rapid communication across distributed infrastructure and external storage backends. No complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio prioritizes compute density over expansive memory footprints, reducing unused memory overhead for processor-bound tasks. Workloads must be compatible with the arm64 instruction set to execute natively. Primary workload fits include multi-threaded code compilation, parallel compute tasks, container clusters, continuous integration runners, and high-concurrency web serving.
